text: Mayor and Councillors Vrbanovic, Davey, Jr.: Good evening everyone and welcome to the special council meeting on January 20, 2025.

Individuals interested in participating in this evening's meeting were eligible to register online using the delegation registration form at www.kitchener.ca slash delegation or via email at delegation at kitchener dot ca.
Any written comments received prior to the commencement of this evening's meeting will
be circulated prior to the meeting and will form part of the public record.
The meeting live stream and archived videos are available at www.kitchener.ca.
Before we begin this evening's meeting, I'd like to begin as we always do by acknowledging
that this evening we're gathering on the traditional territory of the neutral Anishinaabeg and
We recognize our responsibility to serve as stewards for the land and honour the original
caretakers who came before us. Our community is enriched by the enduring knowledge and
deep-rooted traditions of the diverse First Nations, Métis and Inuit and Kitchener today.
Are there any disclosures of pecuniary interest? There being none and there being no delegations,
we'll go right into the agenda. And there is one item to go in caucus for and it's a
labour relations matter moved by Councillor SINGH, seconded by Councillor Ioannidis.
All those in favour? Opposed? That's carried. Motion to adjourn. Councillor Michaud and Councillor Chapman.
All those in favour? Opposed? That's carried. Thank you.
